q1_online_learning.question: Can AAA-1K learn online?
q1_online_learning.statistic: first-quarter minus last-quarter mean normalized error, paired by stream

q2_adaptation.question: Does continued learning help after an unannounced change?
q2_adaptation.statistic: frozen minus online mean normalized error after the branch, paired by stream

q3_hidden_state.question: Does persistent recurrent state provide measurable value?
q3_hidden_state.statistic: control minus AAA-1K mean normalized error, paired by stream

q4_gating.note: the ungated control has 954 parameters against 994, so this compares mechanisms at close to matched capacity, not a large model against a small one
q4_gating.question: Does gated recurrence provide value beyond plain recurrence?
q4_gating.statistic: ungated RNN minus AAA-1K mean normalized error, paired by stream

q5_retention.question: Does the model preserve prior capability across A, B, A?

reacquisition_gap.definition: A2 tail minus A1 tail; positive means the model came back worse

q5_retention.statistic: mean normalized error over the last quarter of each labelled segment

q6_error_calibration.caveat: this is a learned error-magnitude estimate, not a calibrated predictive distribution and not a Bayesian posterior
q6_error_calibration.question: Can the model estimate its own likely error?
q6_error_calibration.units: normalized displacement, the same units the error head is trained in

q7_baseline_competitiveness.decision_rule: a win requires the whole 95% interval above zero, declared in advance
q7_baseline_competitiveness.question: Does the extra complexity beat simpler AAA baselines anywhere?
q7_baseline_competitiveness.statistic: baseline minus AAA-1K mean normalized error, paired by stream

capability_vector.note: dimensions are reported separately and are not combined into a single score

replication_plan.note: the pilot uses development streams only; the bound was applied because an unbounded count would be decided by pilot noise rather than by the design

metadata.scoring: the quantized observable; the latent continuous position is never a target
